function: Load-selective static-hold/dynamic-slide ratio, beyond a homogeneous surface's constant ratio

homogeneous_control: Every height-only single calibrated family has constant Fs/Fd, independent of normal force
equal_resource_ordinary_control: May assemble same separately calibrated families with same information; no exclusive construction or algorithmic superiority claimed
admission_limits: Mixed surface material compliance and transfer of single-contact calibration not experimentally verified
No manufacturing, safety or actual commerce
stopping: One prescribed geometry, no parameter or threshold retuning; accept only modeled function test, HOLD physical/newindustry claims
